stem:
Priya pushes a stationary shopping trolley in a supermarket, and it starts to roll forward.
What does this show about the effect of the applied force?

options.text: The force changed the trolley's state of motion from rest to movement.
The force only changed the colour of the trolley.
The force had no effect because the trolley was at rest.
The force changed the trolley's motion into a change of shape.

teacher.key_rationale: A force applied to a stationary object can make it move from rest, changing its state of motion; options B, C and D deny or misstate this effect.
